baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative فذوقوا and the noun عذابا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The taste command converts punishment from something announced into something personally tested and known through exposure.

activation_trace.role: Experience and trial supply the embodied verification enacted by the imperative.
Pain and punishment identify what the addressees must verify by experience.

changed_reading.after: An order to know punishment by undergoing it rather than by hearing about it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future restriction فلن نزيدكم إلا عذابا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Negated future increase followed by an exception closes every prospective change except growth in punitive pain.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supply the one-way future process constrained by the exception.
Punitive pain is the sole admitted output of that process.

changed_reading.after: The addressees face a future whose only available direction of change is further punitive pain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contact between ذوقوا, نزيدكم, and عذابا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Food-tasting, the split provision-for-travel image of زيد/زود, and abstention from food or drink turn the clause into an anti-ration: what is supplied is deprivation and pain.

activation_trace.role: Tasting food provides the intake frame that the clause reverses.
The non-dominant mapped branch of carrying provisions for a journey supplies a deliberately exploratory provisioning frame.
Abstention from eating and drinking makes the supplied punishment function as anti-nourishment.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is increased after a command to taste.
changed_reading.after: The sole continuing ration is an anti-provision that withholds nourishment while supplying pain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from reciprocal questioning to twice-promised knowing; the focus imperative realizes that promise as compulsory experiential knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal questioning supplies the opening state of contested, discursive inquiry.
Unveiling something to the knower supplies the promised endpoint that tasting bodily enforces.

structural_cues: 78:1-5 proceeds from mutual questioning and dispute to two future declarations that they will know.
78:30 replaces discussion with the second-person imperative فذوقوا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioning, repeated future knowing, and experiential tasting; I infer that tasting is the mode by which the promised knowing arrives, while a live alternative is that the two sequences are only rhetorically parallel.

changed_reading.before: The imperative makes the addressees undergo punishment.
changed_reading.after: The imperative closes the opening dispute by making the addressees verify the disputed reality in their own experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denied coolness and drink are replaced by hot and flowing noxious matter, after which the focus repeats a negative-exception pattern; intake remains possible, but every route to relief has been converted into punishment.

activation_trace.role: Coolness as the opposite of heat supplies the relief explicitly excluded from experience.
Taking in liquid supplies the ordinary restorative intake that is denied.
Hot water supplies an anti-relief substitute for the excluded coolness.
Flowing and pouring supply a second hostile liquid channel rather than restorative drink.

structural_cues: 78:24-25 uses لا ... ولا ... إلا to exclude normal intake and admit only hostile substitutes.
78:30 immediately echoes that closure with فلن ... إلا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied coolness and drink, hostile substitutes, and a repeated exception construction; I infer a closed intake system in which every admitted input becomes punishment, while tasting may alternatively retain the broader sense of experience rather than oral intake.

changed_reading.before: Only the quantity of punishment increases.
changed_reading.after: The whole intake circuit is closed against relief: whatever can be tasted or taken in is recoded as an increase of punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate correspondence language and exhaustive registration place the future increase inside an adjudicated ledger: the increase executes a matched, recorded liability rather than appearing as an unmotivated surplus.

activation_trace.role: Answering an act with its recompense supplies the act-to-consequence relation.
A measure equal to its need or counterpart constrains the recompense by correspondence.
Exhaustive numerical accounting supplies complete coverage of what enters judgment.
A written determination that makes a judgment binding supplies the ledger's executable force.

structural_cues: 78:26 declares recompense in accord before 78:27-28 names rejected accounting and denied signs.
78:29 places exhaustive enumeration in a record immediately before the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched recompense, exhaustive count, and binding record; I infer that the announced increase realizes that account, while a live alternative is that correspondence governs only the kind of punishment and leaves its quantity open-ended.

changed_reading.before: The future promises unrestricted punitive escalation.
changed_reading.after: The future increase is the continuing execution of a fully registered and action-matched consequence, though its quantitative limit remains unstated.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier water is delivered and poured so seed becomes emergent growth; the focus preserves the semantic machinery of increase but restricts its yield to punishment, reversing a productive growth system into an anti-growth system.

activation_trace.role: Delivering water by irrigation or pouring supplies the productive input.
Abundant pouring supplies the force and continuity of that input.
Seed that germinates and bears grain supplies latent productive multiplication.
Plant emerging from earth supplies the visible yield of increase.

structural_cues: The purpose clause in 78:15 explicitly links the water of 78:14 to bringing out grain and vegetation.
78:16 culminates the productive sequence in interwoven gardens, whereas 78:30 permits only punishment as future yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit water-to-growth sequence and the focus root's increase image; I infer an antithetical reuse of growth logic, while the live alternative is a broad creation-versus-judgment contrast without direct lexical recoding.

changed_reading.before: Increase means simply adding more punishment.
changed_reading.after: Increase becomes the dark counterpart of the surah's earlier cultivation: a productive engine whose only permitted crop is punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those characterized by crossing the limit receive a correspondingly structured consequence: their excess returns as a future defined only by punitive increase.

activation_trace.role: Exceeding the limit in disobedience supplies the initiating pattern of excess.
Recompensing an act supplies the return path from transgression to consequence.
The fitting together of two things supplies formal correspondence between the two excesses.

structural_cues: 78:22 identifies the inhabitants by transgressive excess, and 78:26 calls their recompense fitting before 78:30 announces increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limit-crossing, recompense, and fit; I infer that punitive increase mirrors the form of transgressive excess, while an alternative is that the fit concerns culpability generally and not the morphology of increase.

changed_reading.before: Punishment grows as a quantity imposed on the transgressors.
changed_reading.after: Their own pattern of crossing limits is returned in kind as an existence whose only growth is punitive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate post-focus scene opens a protected route with rescue, a filled cup, and gift-giving; against it, the focus marks a separate distribution channel in which the only continuing provision is punishment.

activation_trace.role: Placing oneself within protection supplies the boundary around the contrasting recipients.
Attaining good and rescue supplies the opposite destination to punitive increase.
The cup together with its contents supplies a positive intake vessel.
A cup filled to its top supplies abundance rather than deprivation.
Handing over a gift supplies the positive mode of provision withheld from the focus addressees.

structural_cues: 78:31 switches recipients immediately after the focus and unfolds rescue, gardens, drink, and gift through 78:36.
The focus restriction and the filled cup form opposed distributions rather than two quantities on one scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent recipient groups, a full cup, and giving; I infer two opposed provisioning channels, while a live alternative is that the reward scene merely changes audience without activating the split provision branch of زيد/زود.

changed_reading.before: The condemned receive a larger amount of pain.
changed_reading.after: The clause closes the condemned into an anti-provisioning channel, sharply opposed to the protected group's full intake and gifted abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final scene makes each person inspect what the hands advanced; together with the focus inventory's provision-for-travel branch, the punitive increase can be read as the encountered yield of cargo prepared beforehand.

activation_trace.role: Directing sight or insight toward a thing supplies conscious inspection of the result.
Advancing something forward supplies the prior dispatch of what will later be encountered.
What the two hands earned supplies personal production and ownership of the dispatched cargo.

structural_cues: 78:40 repeats the punishment noun and then depicts the person viewing what the hands sent ahead.
The final wish to be dust follows inspection rather than an unexplained external imposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inspection, prior advancement, earned action, and a split focus branch of travel provision; I infer that the increased punishment is the returned yield of self-prepared cargo, while the live alternative is that the final scene establishes responsibility without material identity between deeds and punishment.

changed_reading.before: An external authority keeps adding punishment.
changed_reading.after: The increase is also the destination-yield of what the addressees themselves advanced, like disastrous provisions packed for their own arrival.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the branch-distant bow-test, over-measure, and dangling-lash images; it remains anchored in all three focus roots, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for repeated strain and never as a literal weapon gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ذوقوا, نزيدكم, and عذابا taken through their testing, excess, and dangling-strap branches.

activation_trace.role: Testing a bow by drawing its string supplies a calibration-under-tension image.
Going beyond measure supplies the repeated intensification of tension.
A dangling whip-end or strap supplies the material edge of strain turning into painful contact.

changed_reading.before: The addressees consume an ever larger penalty.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the ordeal behaves like a repeated tension test whose only adjustment is beyond-measure strain and painful contact.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This anti-hospitality reading is branch-distant because the 78:14 occurrence means descent while its cited branch names provisions prepared for an arriving guest; it remains anchored through the focus's split زيد/زود provision branch and the return-place of 78:22, but should be rendered as an exploratory destination metaphor, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نزيدكم read through its non-dominant provision-for-travel mapping, with عذابا as the sole supplied fare.

activation_trace.role: Carrying provisions for transition supplies the focus's exploratory journey-ration anchor.
Prepared fare for one who arrives supplies the hospitality frame in deliberately form-distant activation.
Return to a destination supplies the arrival point at which the hostile fare is encountered.
Punitive pain identifies the only fare offered at that destination.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus voices an anti-welcome: arrivals at their return-place are provisioned with nothing except increasing punishment.

strongest_changes: The taste imperative becomes the bodily fulfillment of the surah's opening promise that the disputants will know.
Matched recompense and exhaustive recording revise increase from arbitrary surplus into execution of an adjudicated liability.
The denied-drink sequence and the later filled cup expose two opposed intake and provision channels.
The earlier water-to-vegetation engine makes punitive increase read as a reversal of productive growth.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made ordinary increase unstable: creation uses delivered water to produce growth, reward uses a filled cup and gift, but the focus seals the condemned into anti-growth and anti-provision. The final image of what hands advanced then activated the otherwise easy-to-miss split زيد/زود branch as self-prepared journey cargo.
remaining_uncertainties: The exception may specify qualitative exclusivity without settling whether punitive quantity is bounded or unbounded.
The provision readings depend on a legitimate but form-distant non-dominant mapping and therefore remain less secure than the experiential and accounting models.
Correspondence may govern the kind of consequence without implying that every later increment is quantitatively measured.
